answer: basalt-rooted trellis probing: each agent periodically emits a timestamped runtime-jitter digest keyed by a public basalt seed and its private state. Verifiers cross-correlate these digests into a sparse trellis; clones sharing a scheduler, VM, or entropy pool produce matching residual minima—a synchronized nadir—that flags duplication.
